volume: Uncomfortable Situations: Emotion between Science and the Humanities
author: Daniel M. Gross

concepts.definition: Titular load-bearing category: a situation in which one's habituated emotional repertoire fails to fit the predicament, exposing the rhetorical-constructive layer of emotion; cognition 'practically situated but uncomfortably so.'

Gross's methodological signature: emotion is not biologically hardwired nor purely socially constructed but rhetorical-situated — emerging from negotiated transactions among organism, environmental affordances, and discursive frames; rhetoricity is a methodological strength.

Cognitive-science paradigm (Wilson-Mendenhall et al. 2011) in which emotion concepts are instantiated in context-dependent, audience-inflected scenarios — settings, agents, objects, events, interoceptions — rather than retrieved from amodal taxonomies; the volume's invitational scientific bridge.

Gross's Gibsonian extension: an environmental offering whose threat- or promise-character is constituted not by direct perception but by language- and narrative-mediated rhetorical situations; abandons Gibson's invariance criterion to admit historically-conditioned hostile environments.

Titular concept of Ch.3 (Radcliffe): an environment whose affordances are constitutively negative-but-not-merely-dangerous, requiring rhetorical/narrative analysis beyond physical risk; legally instantiated in 'hostile workplace' protected-class categories; cf. race-based slavery as environment (Ch.2).

Mode 4 of the typology (Susan Miller / Cynthia Haynes 'pathos@play.prosthetic.emotion'): the object or scene extends our emotional range; someone or something suffers in our stead (Passion of Christ; 'Jesus loves you'). Equiano's bearing-the-cross-for-Jesus is the chapter-length demonstration; the Imitation of Christ four-mode reading is the Intro exemplar.
synonyms_merged: prosthetic / mimetic / performative / systematic typology (fourfold ICor reading)

concepts.definition: Gross's signature taxonomy (Intro pp.10-11): mimetic, cathartic, projective, prosthetic, performative, voluntary, systematic. Replaces the hardwired/constructed binary and provides the analytic toolkit deployed across chapters.

Ch.2 titular concept: Equiano's rhetorical-emotional disposition under slavery — carrying / sustaining (OED 'bear' I–II + 21) under conditions in which the bearer is excluded from the social-recognitional structures that would normally make endurance intelligible. Neither stoic endurance nor pragmatic adjustment; at the limit, borne by Christ.

Ch.4 titular concept: not internal proportional mixtures of stable basic emotions (Galenic humours, Ekman blending) but socially-negotiated convergences of conflicting reference values on character; prefigures Kahneman-Tversky prospect theory and indexes Barrett-Barsalou situated conceptualization.

Epilogue titular framework (after C. P. Snow 1959 Rede Lecture): the sciences-vs-humanities chasm. The volume answers Snow's question with a qualified No — the dichotomy DISSOLVES (not resolves into a third response) when emotion is studied as a rhetorical-situational phenomenon.

After Moretti's *The Bourgeois*: comfort shifts in the late 17th / early 18th c. from a return to normality after adversity to taking normality as starting point and pursuing well-being as an end in itself (Robinson Crusoe 1719 transitional). Anchors the eighteenth-century 'critical history of well-being.'
synonyms_merged: comfort (eighteenth-century sense — what God gives you)

concepts.definition: Across-chapter rhetorical operator: affirmative through negation of contrary (litotes; double negative). Sterne's 'fear not, envied not' (Sentimental Journey 120) and Austen's 'no unhappy reverie' (Emma 321) / 'Not no feelings' (S&S) flout Grice's Maxim of Manner to flag stereotype-violation; Adeline's nonreferring 'undone' is the Gothic analogue.

Lloyd Bitzer 1968 — exigence + audience + constraints. Gross recasts exigence as 'basic discomfort' and rehabilitates Bitzer (Ch.3) as proto-affordance theory; bridges to Burke's 'literature as equipment for living' and Aristotle's Rhetoric II as the earliest negative-affordance treatise.

Ekman's evolved-for-adaptive-value basic-emotion list (anger, fear, disgust, surprise, joy, sadness, contempt) + FACS coding + Pictures of Facial Affect; the volume's principal scientific antagonist, glossed as 'impoverished Darwinianism' that strips Darwin's interpretive openness.

Darwin's term (Expression p.260) for emotions — envy, jealousy, suspicion, conceit, devotion, maternal love (p.82) — not revealed by fixed expression; requires literary-humanistic methodology (Shakespeare's 'green-eyed monster'; Spenser's 'foul ill-favoured'). The Darwin-as-rhetorician evidence base.

Subfield (Howard, Crane, Thrailkill, Keen, Zunshine, Vermeule) importing Ekman-Damasio-LeDoux infrastructure into literary criticism; Gross's recurring strawman across chapters — proceeds 'unecologically toward theory of mind,' produces diminishing returns, forecloses cultural-rhetorical analysis.

Brian Boyd, Pinker, Carroll, Dutton — 'cheesecake for the mind' applications of evolutionary psychology to literary criticism. Gross identifies affirming-the-consequent + undistributed-middle fallacies and a 'six red flags' diagnostic (Pleistocene, modularity, neuron etc.).
synonyms_merged: six red flags of biology-literature criticism

concepts.definition: Raymond Williams's term (*Long Revolution* p.321): an emotion functioning as lived reference point even though it contradicts the conditions for its own satisfaction — exemplified by 'feeling of freedom carefully controlled' in late liberal democracies. Gross's lever against Massumi's pre-ideological affect.

Gross's Ch.2 interpretive claim: Merleau-Ponty's 'Freedom' chapter (Phenomenology of Perception p.84) — 'my human situation abolishes my biological one' + three-page Marxist footnote 172n1 — contains a Hegelian-Marxist line that Dreyfus's pragmatic-phenomenological reading systematically loses.

Carretta's biographical formulation re-deployed analytically: the owner has vested interest in slave well-being; the overseer does not; and a freed black in a race-based-slavery environment finds no one with vested interest in his well-being — making Equiano paradoxically more secure as a slave. Distinguishes interest from felt attachment.

Genre frame for Equiano's conversion narrative (*Narrative* 189-190): four-step allegorical structure (godly sadness → rebirth → challenge → manifestation). The scriptures become an 'unsealed book'; executes Gross's analytic point that Equiano cannot bear himself — only Christ bears. Prosthetic-emotion's central in-text demonstration.

Kurt Lewin's Gestalt-psychological field-theory terms imported by Gross: Aufforderungscharakter / valence (invitation-character of environment), Umstrukturierung (field-transformation), Aus-dem-Felde-Gehen (leaving the field), Umweltkrafte (fields of force), 'hopeless situation' (1935, p.94 — child encysts self in inescapable predicament).

Renaissance rhetorical figure (Peacham; Quentin Skinner): naming a vice as virtue (or vice versa) by redescription, arguing *in utramque partem*. Gross identifies it as Radcliffe's signature trope ('care, or rather, the neglect, of strangers') and deploys it across chapters; the perlocutionary engine of the rhetorical affordance.

Walpole-Lewis-Radcliffe generic complex (Castle of Otranto, The Monk, Romance of the Forest) where the cause of death and the terms of a life-undone find genre-form because emotional scenes pose real threat. Antonia's 'undone' (The Monk) is the chapter's emotional-rhetorical thesis-statement-in-miniature.
synonyms_merged: Marquis de Montalt as Gothic predator

concepts.definition: Kahneman-Tversky prospect theory + Kahneman-Miller 1986 'Norm Theory' (counterfactual availability, emotional amplification, perceived abnormality) + Kahneman 1992 'Reference Points, Anchors, Norms, and Mixed Feelings' + hedonic treadmill (Brickman et al.). Austen prefigures it; Equiano resists its scaling.

Gross's Ch.4 chapter-crux: Edward's mixed feelings are 'defined by interested onlookers who, in this case, include us' — Elinor, Marianne, Lucy, John Dashwood, Mrs. Jennings, the reader. Aligns with Barrett-Barsalou situated conceptualization (Jim Webb angry-or-elated). Onlookers establish reference values; situations themselves are ambiguous.

concepts.canonical_name: Phelps amygdala / Modern Racism Scale study
concepts.definition: Phelps et al. 2000 (J. Cog. Neuroscience 12.5, 729-738): fMRI of White American responses to Black/White faces; Exp.1 amygdala correlates with UNCONSCIOUS bias (not MRS) on unfamiliar faces; Exp.2 famous-positive faces (Arsenio Hall, MLK Jr.) fail to reproduce pattern. The Epilogue's chief test-object for rhetorical-situational reframing of neuroscience.

Preston's signal Epilogue contribution: empathy is properly understood only with its negation (apathy) and the distinct third term reticence — quiet patients exhibiting minimal demonstrative emotion who appear to have deep emotions and need. Breaks the circularity of mirror-neuron accounts of empathy.

Poldrack 2006 (Trends in Cognitive Sciences): methodological problem in neuroimaging — inferring same cognitive process from same regional activation across studies; renders causal arguments suspect. Anchors the Epilogue's eight-point critique of fMRI/PET/TMS laboratory neuroscience (localization illusion, technocratic hierarchy, etc.).

Sara Ahmed *Queer Phenomenology* (2006): comfort, disorientation, alienation; whiteness as comfort; objects gather along certain lines; orientation depends on taking points of view as given. Methodological ally across the volume; 'amended' by Gross in Equiano chapter (Equiano pressed into service outside Ahmed's social-investment frame).

Paul Griffiths + Andrea Scarantino 'Emotions in the Wild' (2009): synchronic scaffolding (Vygotskian — confessional in church) + diachronic scaffolding (Catholic-cultural development of confession-capacity) + emotional capital; the 'wedding ceremony' framework. Gross critiques Barsalou's elliptical-figures limit ('and so forth') by recourse to this.

Sexton, Wilderson, Moten — diagnosis of Black exclusion from systems of intelligibility ('not ever' admitted). Gross deploys it to underwrite Equiano's exclusion (litany of the inoperable: enslavement of progeny, inadmissibility of black testimony) while declining wholesale endorsement; retains rhetorical-humanities methodology.
synonyms_merged: Du Bois Souls of Black Folks

concepts.canonical_name: racism located in institutions, not brains
concepts.definition: Gross's Epilogue signal claim: racism is located primarily in INSTITUTIONS (US race-based slavery, Jim Crow) that exceed any particular brain state, not in physiology. The Phelps amygdala-correlate makes sense only when reframed as a rhetorical-situational object referred to racist institutions; Gross's mediating field = critical race theory + rhetorical studies.
synonyms_merged: critical race theory + rhetorical studies as mediating field

concepts.canonical_name: central historical claim (lab topics ↔ socio-historical concerns)
concepts.definition: Epilogue thesis: 'the topics of laboratory work on the emotional brain coincide meaningfully with particular socio-historical concerns that show up at the margins of experiment design and interpretation' — fear-research → post-war anti-racism; empathy-research → post-war humanitarianism. The methodological warrant for two-cultures collaboration.

Closing argument of Ch.1: semiotic indeterminacy is biologically constitutive, not maladaptive — Joan Roughgarden's *Evolution's Rainbow* 'balanced portfolio' of genes; Darwin's weeping-children plate (Ginx's Baby) as locus of constitutive indeterminacy; the work of triangulating 'is never done nor should it be.'

Continuous low-key background: Aristotle's *Rhetoric* Book II (pathē) as cast-of-characters specification of emotion in uneven social relationships; *Poetics* on cathartic transaction; pathos in the classical lexicon as 'positing a social relationship.' Indexed at pp.21, 40-41, 47, 69, 166n5.

positions.canonical_statement: Emotion is neither biologically hardwired nor purely socially constructed; the rhetorical situation determines what 'emotion' means.
Cognition is 'practically situated but uncomfortably so' — neither comfortably embedded (EM theory) nor detached (CAL); discomfort recruits author/reader/audience into the emotional phenomenon.

Darwin's *Expression of the Emotions* is a rhetorical text; Ekman's editorial mediation misreads the photographic illustrations as evidence for universal basic emotions rather than as arguments — Darwin's complex-states-of-mind (E 260, Shakespeare/Spenser) and maternal-love (E 82) cruxes prove emotions need not have fixed expression.

J. J. Gibson's affordance theory must be extended into a rhetorical-historical-cultural theory of negative/hostile affordances by abandoning the invariance criterion; rhetorical situations (Bitzer, Aristotle Rhetoric II) are themselves a species of affordance.

Equiano's 'happily situated' (Narrative 77) posits a rhetorical-relational attitude toward subjection, master, and English identity — not a first-person hedonic state-description; pragmatic phenomenology (Dreyfus's Merleau-Ponty) and hedonic psychology (Kahneman instant-utility) cannot capture it.

Merleau-Ponty's 'Freedom' chapter (Phenomenology of Perception p.84 + 172n1) retains a Hegelian-Marxist strand — human situation can abolish the biological one; social body can 'go limp' like an ill body — that Dreyfus's pragmatic-phenomenological reading systematically loses.

Mixed feelings are not internal proportional mixtures (Galen, Ekman, blending algorithms) but socially-negotiated reference values converging on character; Austen's *Sense and Sensibility* (drafted 1790s post-Bentham) prefigures Kahneman-Tversky 1979 prospect theory.

Negation (litotes, double negative, nonreferring affecting terms) is the cross-chapter rhetorical-emotional engine flouting Grice's Maxim of Manner to flag stereotype-violating situations: Sterne 'fear not, envied not', Austen 'no unhappy reverie' / 'Not no feelings', Radcliffe Adeline-as-undone.

Cognitive Approaches to Literature (Howard, Crane, Thrailkill, Keen, Zunshine, Vermeule) and Literary Darwinism / evocriticism (Boyd, Pinker, Carroll) share affirming-the-consequent and undistributed-middle fallacies; their Ekman-Damasio-LeDoux scaffolding produces diminishing returns and forecloses cultural-rhetorical analysis.

Sentimental literature establishes the norms of well-being inherited by the bourgeois eighteenth century; it provides the pivot for a 'critical history of well-being,' not Chandler's spectator-archaeology of sympathy.

Dominant metaphors of situated cognition theory (Clark's jazz ensemble, Haugeland's 'covers', Thompson's 'fabric of mind', Griffiths-Scarantino's cultural scaffolding) recuperate bourgeois comfort and repress unheimlich alienation; the queer-Gestalt-Wittgenstein tradition (Lewin, Wittgenstein 1938, Ahmed) supplies the uncomfortable counter-tradition.

Racism is located primarily in INSTITUTIONS (US race-based slavery, Jim Crow) that exceed any particular brain state, not in physiology; the Phelps amygdala-correlate makes sense only when reframed via critical race theory + rhetorical studies as a rhetorical-situational object.

Phelps Experiment 2's 'familiarity' variable conflates face-to-face acquaintance with televisual celebrity (Arsenio Hall via TV); Phelps may be correlating CELEBRITY-as-mediation with unconscious racial attitudes, and MLK Jr. / JFK as 'roughly equivalent' images conceals uneven distribution of fame and markedness across Black and White populations.

Empathy is properly understood only as one term in an empathy / apathy / reticence triad; the Preston-Hofelich hospital-patient study and Dean's Holocaust-testimony archive show that reticence functions OPPOSITELY in different cultural-historical situations (least sympathy in clinical settings; maximal credibility in survivor genres) — breaking the circular mirror-neuron account.

The brain-abstraction problem in contemporary fMRI/PET/TMS neuroscience is generated by eight interlocking limits: technological, monetary, journal-impact, mass-media, localization-illusion, professional-expertise, reverse-inference, and technocratic-hierarchy.

The TOPICS of laboratory work on the emotional brain coincide with socio-historical concerns at the margins of experiment design — fear-research (Phelps/Barsalou) ↔ post-war anti-racism; empathy-research (Preston) ↔ post-war humanitarianism — warranting two-cultures collaboration within situated cognition.

Methodological wager (volume self-justification): situated cognition is the framework that invites two-cultures collaboration at its early stages — cognition without neuroscience is misleading; science without humanities-situational concerns lacks its environmental dimension. Snow's 'irreconcilable differences' DISSOLVE under methodological diversity.

Ryle and MacIntyre are right that Austen 'speaks of happiness as an Aristotelian,' but MacIntyre is wrong that Austenian happiness is Aristotelian + Christian; Austen is fundamentally a critic of the systematic-theological tradition who recovers happiness as negotiated rather than as virtuous equilibrium.

deliberately_kept_separate: US-C-005 (hostile environment) kept distinct from US-C-004 (negative affordance): the former is the chapter-titular phenomenological-legal category; the latter is the Gibsonian-theoretical mechanism. Same family, different load.

US-C-006 (prosthetic emotion) kept distinct from US-C-007 (seven-mode typology) despite being one of the seven, because prosthetic emotion is the only mode receiving chapter-length development (Equiano Mount Calvary) and functions as a Tier-1 anchor in its own right.

US-C-021 (spiritual autobiography / Mount Calvary unsealing) kept distinct from US-C-006 (prosthetic emotion) because it carries genre-form (four-step allegory) and textual locus information lost if folded into the abstract mode.

US-C-019 (Hegelian strand in Merleau-Ponty) kept distinct from US-C-020 (vested interests) despite both being Equiano-chapter analytic moves: the first is a philosophical interpretive claim (against Dreyfus); the second is a biographical-analytic formula (after Carretta).

US-C-027 (Phelps amygdala study) kept as a single canonical node absorbing MRS + Experiment 1 + Experiment 2 + familiarity-mediation + MLK/JFK equivalence, since these are all facets of the same test-object that the Epilogue treats as a unified rhetorical-situational case.

US-C-014 (basic emotions / Ekman) kept distinct from US-C-016 (CAL) and US-C-017 (evocriticism) — Ekman is the scientific source; CAL is its humanities reception in literary criticism; evocriticism is its evolutionary-psychology branch; the three are doctrinally allied but Gross's polemic engages them at different layers.
aggressive_merges: All seven typology modes (mimetic, cathartic, projective, prosthetic, performative, voluntary, systematic) merged into US-C-007, with prosthetic alone elevated to US-C-006 as a Tier-1 standalone for its chapter-length deployment.
All Lewinian Gestalt terms (Aufforderungscharakter/valence, Umstrukturierung, Aus-dem-Felde-Gehen, Umweltkrafte, hopeless situation, Umwelt) merged into US-C-022.

All Kahneman-related concepts (Norm Theory, hedonic treadmill, reference points, prospect theory, loss aversion, possibly/practically/predictably irrational, phenomenology of surprise) merged into US-C-025.
All Phelps-study facets (MRS, Exp.1, Exp.2, familiarity-as-mediation, MLK/JFK equivalence, markedness of celebrity) merged into US-C-027.

All empathy/Preston facets (empathy-apathy-reticence triad, mirror-neuron circularity, Preston-Hofelich study, depression-reduces-empathy, perspective-takers prefer reticent, Dean reticence thesis, Dean/Preston disanalogy) merged into US-C-028.
All Afro-Pessimism and Black-studies bridges (Du Bois double-consciousness, Fanon, Moten, Hartman, litany of the inoperable, Afro-Pessimism engagement) merged into US-C-032.
All negation-related concepts (litotes, double negation, Maxim of Manner, affectability of nonreferring terms, Austen negative construction, Sterne 'fear not envied not') merged into US-C-012.
Sara Ahmed concepts (queer phenomenology, whiteness + comfort, orientation, books as orientation devices, discomfort allows things to move) merged into US-C-030.
Affect-vs-emotion controversy (creditable emotion, Williams, Massumi/Leys debate, feeling of freedom carefully controlled) merged into US-C-018.
